experiment: Xyce after a failed .STEP point, a singular .OP, and its output (the Xyce runner, 2026-10-16, phase 2): a tran .STEP g LIST 1e-7 1e-3 2e-7 whose second point (G1 a negative conductance kicked by a pulse) fails; an .OP with a node that has no DC path; a 6001-point .NOISE and a tran of one circuit
result: a tran .STEP point that fails does not stop the run: Xyce goes on with the next point, exits 0 and appends that point's rows to the failed one's plot (2 plots for 3 points; the time restarts inside the second, "Step 2 of 3"), so only the restart of the time inside a plot and the plots' `Step k of n` names show which point failed; a singular .OP exits 1 ("Failed DC sweep steps") and writes no print file; a noise analysis prints no `Percent complete`, a tran does (Xyce's block-buffered stdout into a file or pipe is TestStdoutBuffering's)
rules: §7.2: a tran plot whose time restarts, or fewer plots than the .STEP points, is a failed analysis (status 1), the first failed group giving failed_points
§7.2: a non-zero exit with no print file is a failed analysis
§2.7 / §7.2: SIGUSR1's status line reads Xyce's last `Percent complete`, which a noise analysis never prints

contains: Time step too small near step number
